'''Parein II''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Sarin sector/Legends|Sarin sector]].

==History==
The planet had at least four [[Moon/Legends|moons]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|13|Parein II}}</ref> the fourth of which, [[Parein II 4/Legends|Parein II 4]], was the site of the [[Battle of Parein II 4/Legends|Battle of Parein II 4]].

[[Churhee's Riflemen]] often trained in the savanna setting of Parein II.
